Rule / approved behavior: GET order list/detail and shipping fulfillment list/detail only. No order writes or production OAuth.
Example / giải thích: Local test token; seller context verified.

Rule / approved behavior: S01 mandatory fields are project policy; vendor OAS lacks exhaustive required[]. Conditional vendor fields may be omitted.
Example / giải thích: Không áp NOT NULL của website lên mọi API field.

Rule / approved behavior: Bounded lastmodifieddate; do not combine with creationdate because creation filter takes precedence.
Example / giải thích: Đơn cũ vừa cập nhật vẫn được lấy.

Rule / approved behavior: getOrders: limit default50/max200, offset zero-based; preserve total/href and conditional next/prev. Local S01 limit1.
Example / giải thích: Một order không chứng minh được multi-page recovery.

Rule / approved behavior: Freeze simulator during S01 reads; provider offset paging has no guaranteed snapshot isolation. Use reconciliation for moving pages.
Example / giải thích: Không bảo đảm đủ dữ liệu chỉ vì giữ nguyên time window.

Rule / approved behavior: Shipping list exposes fulfillments/total/warnings, not getOrders pagination parameters.
Example / giải thích: Không tự thêm next/offset cho endpoint này.

Rule / approved behavior: pricingSummary.tax is conditional on tax applied. Omit in tax-free S01; old draft zeros are corrected to MISSING.
Example / giải thích: Expected USD62 unchanged. Missing source tax is not universal zero.

Rule / approved behavior: priceDiscount/deliveryDiscount may be negative. Preserve sign; do not apply website nonnegative discount validation.
Example / giải thích: Không trừ giá trị âm hai lần.

Rule / approved behavior: lineItemCost = unit×quantity before discount. discountedLineItemCost conditional; never multiply lineItemCost again.
Example / giải thích: Blue2 units = USD40.

Rule / approved behavior: Keep pricingSummary.total/components; S01 total=gross62 only because chosen costs zero. Other fees/remitted taxes/adjustments require expanded reconciliation.
Example / giải thích: Không gọi source total là net revenue.

Rule / approved behavior: Line key source+seller+order+lineItemId. SKU may be absent in legacy model. Map scoped listing/variation/product references.
Example / giải thích: Missing SKU does not erase transaction.

Rule / approved behavior: getOrders cancelRequests always[]; use cancelState/getOrder details. S01 NONE_REQUESTED.
Example / giải thích: List [] không phải complete cancellation evidence.

Rule / approved behavior: Derive PARTIALLY_SHIPPED from dated shipment allocations and remaining units; IN_PROGRESS alone insufficient.
Example / giải thích: Blue2 shipped; white1 not shipped.

Rule / approved behavior: FULFILLED means considered shipped. No DELIVERED assertion without additional evidence.
Example / giải thích: Carrier delivery integration outside initial endpoints.

Rule / approved behavior: Keep entire S01 blue line in FUL001, white line not allocated. Follow selected vendor guide restriction on keeping line together.
Example / giải thích: FUL002 possible later, not in approved baseline.

Rule / approved behavior: Order+later fulfillment calls are not one atomic snapshot; keep timestamps and reconcile inconsistent evidence.
Example / giải thích: Paused fixture reads do not prove real-source atomicity.

Rule / approved behavior: Duplicate version/content → no history duplicate; older snapshot cannot regress current; same timestamp/different content → conflict.
Example / giải thích: Atomic compare at current write.

Rule / approved behavior: Shared overlap120sec; separate acquisition/processing; max5 total attempts. Raw pages/details become durable work before acquisition advances.
Example / giải thích: Missing/malformed required page leaves window incomplete.

Rule / approved behavior: Empty successful order page != outage. Retain warnings; 404 detail does not delete order. Optional missing values never filled with false/zero.
Example / giải thích: Entity validation and quarantine preserve raw evidence.

Rule / approved behavior: Official OASv1.20.7 checked19Oct2026. API reference and older guide differ on lookback; don't hardcode universal90-day claim.
Example / giải thích: Backfill guarantee must be independently verified.
